description: This file implements a class for monitoring and handling network manager events via D-Bus on GNOME/NetworkManager, including device state changes, IP address updates, WiFi scan results, and interface status, with callbacks and signal handling.

classes.name: GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
classes.description: Class responsible for monitoring NetworkManager events via D-Bus, handling device state changes, IP address updates, WiFi scans, and interface status, with singleton pattern.

methods.name: startNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Starts the network manager event monitoring thread and sets up signal handlers.

methods.name: stopNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Stops the event monitoring thread and cleans up signal handlers.

methods.name: cleanupSignalHandlers
methods.description: Disconnects all signal handlers to prevent leaks.

methods.name: GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
methods.description: Constructor initializing D-Bus client and main loop, establishing connection to NetworkManager.

methods.name: ~GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and stopping event monitoring.

methods.name: networkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Main thread function that sets up signal handlers and runs the main loop for D-Bus events.

methods.name: onActiveInterfaceChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for active interface change, reports old and new interface.

methods.name: onInterfaceStateChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for interface state changes, reports new state.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Callback for WiFi state changes, reports to the application and possibly to MfrMgr.

methods.name: onAddressChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for IP address changes, manages internal cache and reports address status.

methods.name: apToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a network access point to a JSON object with SSID, security, strength, and frequency.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDsCb
methods.description: Callback for WiFi scan results, reports available SSIDs.

methods.name: setwifiScanOptions
methods.description: Configures whether WiFi scan results should be notified periodically.
